original_frozen_case_rules.representative: per raw span stratum closest to within-stratum median span, stable ID tie
original_frozen_case_rules.worst_coverage: largest common raw coverage loss versus reference, stable ID tie
original_frozen_case_rules.worst_error: largest comparable common raw error, stable ID tie
original_frozen_case_rules.near_boundary: smallest positive absolute distance between actual P residual and its registered threshold, stable ID tie
original_frozen_case_rules.direction_case: at least one actual changed D neighborhood if present
original_frozen_case_rules.on_missing: explicit no available case, no hidden substitution

scope: Each locked single candidate on the same120 G2_EVAL records; descriptive case choice only, never parameter selection.
stable_id_tie: lexicographic original record_id string; original index then segment ID for within-record ties
representative: Within each LOW/MIDDLE/HIGH raw-span layer present in G2_EVAL, closest raw span to that layer median; no candidate metrics used. Actual labels are read from existing stratum prefix.
worst_coverage: Largest positive (reference covered count - candidate covered count); no positive loss yields explicit NO_OBSERVED_COVERAGE_LOSS and null case.
worst_error: Largest candidate_max_on_baseline_covered among nonnull comparable readings; report whether actually degraded, do not label largest absolute error automatically as a regression.
near_boundary: Smallest positive abs(actual nonzero immediate-P per-original-index residual - registered tolerance), then stable record/index/segment tie; no new DP calculation.
direction_case: First record with a new adjacent pair in that candidate D output versus its D input, then first pair; record whether reference also has this change. This is stage mechanism, not automatically candidate-vs-reference degradation.
additional_failure: First record violating a frozen protection, or explicit none.
additional_favorable: First strict-gain record under frozen compare, or explicit none.
additional_null: First record where baseline or candidate common/DP error is null, or explicit none.
